placeholders.text: SUBJECT:  Request for Appointment of Source Selection Authority (SSA), [INSERT NAME OF PROGRAM OR ACQUITION], [INSERT SOLICITATION NUMBER]
1.  Request the Deputy Assistant Secretary of the Army sign the attached SSA Appointment Letter for [INSERT NAME OF SSA APPOINTEE].

a.  [INSERT NAME OF REQUIRING ACTIVITY] has a requirement for [INSERT DESCRIPTION OF REQUIRMENT].  The Government will use formal source selection procedures for this acquisition.  The contract will consist of [INSERT BASIC AND OPTION QUANTITIES OR TERM].  This contract will be [INSERT CONTRACT TYPE(S)].  The total estimated value of the acquisition is [INSERT DOLLAR VALUE].

b.  [INSERT NAME OF SSA APPOINTEE] has agreed to be the SSA for the subject procurement.  Army Contracting Command – Rock Island supports [INSERT HIS/HER] appointment as SSA.  [INSERT INFORMATION REGARDING SSA APPOINTEE’S QUALIFICATIONS/REASON FOR SELECTION].  [INSERT NAME OF SSA APPOINTEE]’s exceptional qualifications, as indicated on the attached biography, make [INSERT HIM/HER] the best and most qualified candidate.  [INSERT NAME OF SSA APPOINTEE] received the required Ethics/Standards of Conduct briefing on [INSERT DATE].  The Ethics Advisor has reviewed [INSERT NAME OF SSA APPOINTEE]’s financial disclosure report, [INSERT OGE 450 OR SF 278, AS APPROPRIATE], and has concluded that this candidate has no financial or other conflict of interest with any of the potential offerors.
3.  Recommendation:  I concur with the proposed appointment of [INSERT NAME OF SSA APPOINTEE] and recommend the approval of DASA(P).
